The weighted campus energy balance calculator successfully passed all tests with a perfect reward score, validating the core mathematical logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.85 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite. While the logic is sound, future iterations should re-check edge cases in weighting factors to ensure the 0.85 judge reward is improved to full parity with the verifier.
